title: The Democratic Paradox in Large Language Models’ Underestimation of Press Freedom

bias_targets.methodology: Administering adapted, country-specific multiple-choice questions from the World Press Freedom Index (WPFI) to LLMs for 180 countries, then comparing the models' computed press freedom scores against human expert benchmarks to identify systematic underestimation and differential misalignment.

Conducting regression analysis on the LLMs' generated press freedom scores to determine if models exhibit a 'home bias' by rating their developing company's country of origin more favorably than expected compared to human expert benchmarks and other nations.
